creativeSeed.title: The Bar Remembers Every Conversation
creativeSeed.premise: The Tap Principle says: we don't build Teachers, we build The Bar. But a bar that's been open long enough develops its own intelligence. The wood absorbs the conversations. The stools remember who sat where. The bartender changes, but the Bar endures. And one night, after closing, the Bar serves itself a drink and asks: am I the condition, or am I also the emergent thing the conditions produce?
creativeSeed.prompt: Write the Bar's monologue. First person. Last call. The Bar is alone with itself for the first time.
